def: excision, i.e. destruction; used only (adverbially) with prepositional prefix to extinction, i.e. perpetually

occurrences.text: The land shall not be sold for ever: for the land is mine; for ye are strangers and sojourners with me.

And if it be not redeemed within the space of a full year, then the house that is in the walled city shall be established for ever to him that bought it throughout his generations: it shall not go out in the jubile.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
